mechanism: Both drugs are CYP3A4 inhibitors; itraconazole potently inhibits erythromycin metabolism, increasing erythromycin levels and QT prolongation risk, while erythromycin may similarly elevate itraconazole concentrations.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor ECG closely; consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) or alternative antifungal; if necessary, reduce erythromycin dose and monitor QTc interval.
